name: session_show
title: Show session
description: Show the branch, repository, work Issue, stack record, the base branch to compare against and the worktree of the session. Reads nothing on GitHub; read the Issue and the PRs stacked above with the official GitHub MCP

directory.description: Target Git repository (absolute or relative path)

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the config that includes the target repository; when several do, the active one among them

branch.description: Current branch (omitted when it cannot be read)

repository.description: Repository of the git remote (owner/repo; omitted when it cannot be read)

activeIssue.description: Work Issue of the session (omitted when there is none)

reference.description: Work Issue found from the git remote and the number that ends the branch name (owner/repo/N, the form issue_ref takes)

stack.description: Base the work was stacked on, from .pecot-base (omitted when not stacked)

branch.description: Base branch the work branch is stacked on

sha.description: Commit of the base branch the work started from

baseBranch.description: Remote branch to compare the work against (remote/branch): the stack branch while it is on the remote, else the develop branch (omitted when it cannot be decided)

isWorktree.description: Whether the directory is a linked worktree (omitted when it could not be determined)

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
